text:
BERT4Rec’s masked-reconstruction/terminal-prediction mismatch is established: training reconstructs interior items using both contexts; inference predicts an appended mask using history alone. [Recency Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.02643) explicitly identifies this weak correspondence. The 2024 [Sequential Masked Modeling paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11150) explores masking changes for encoder-only next-item recommendation. These motivate testing terminal-mask frequency or loss weighting within the existing BERT4Rec backbone; they do not establish improvements on the pinned Amazon benchmark.

Component-level methods offer useful tools, with qualifications. [Activation-patching best practices, ICLR 2024](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/06a52a54c8ee03cd86771136bc91eb1f-Abstract-Conference.html) examines sensitivity to corruption and evaluation choices. [AtP*, 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.00745) finds false negatives in gradient-based approximations to activation patching. [PCGrad](https://papers.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2020/file/3fe78a8acf5fda99de95303940a2420c-Paper.pdf) supplies a gradient-conflict framework. Proposed adaptation: on bounded training-history batches, measure layerwise gradient cosine and norm ratios between interior-mask and terminal-mask losses; then verify selected components with actual activation interventions. Gradient disagreement alone does not demonstrate harmful transfer.

Calibration remains an experimental proposal, not a verified BERT4Rec diagnostic from these sources: inject controlled readout or padding faults in diagnostic copies, alongside identical-activation patches and padding-only controls. Report target-margin changes and collateral effects on unaffected examples. Stratify by training-frequency bins and history length: [TCA4Rec, 2025](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40537-025-01184-9) documents popularity imbalance, but frequency correlation alone cannot establish a shortcut. Keep one trained network per category; use probes to motivate training changes, with selection determined solely by pinned four-category macro validation HR@10.
